kata — keybindings

Global
?         help
q/ctrl+c  quit
P         projects
I         Inbox
D         daemons
F         federation
C         credentials
L         toggle layout

Graph
k           up
j           down
up/C-p      scroll up
down/C-n    scroll down
pgup/M-v    page up
pgdown/C-v  page down
g/C-M-<     first
G/C-M->     last
enter       open detail
space       expand/collapse
right       expand
left        collapse
E           expand/collapse all
n           new issue (form)
v           toggle flat/nested view
o           toggle graph order
x           close
r           reopen
u           undo last issue action

Detail
tab/C-j        next tab
shift+tab/C-k  prev tab
enter          jump to referenced issue
esc/backspace  back
e              edit body
c              new comment
p              set parent
b              add blocker
l              add related
+              add label
-              remove label
a              assign owner
A              clear owner
t              timed assignment
!              set priority

Children
N      new child
j/k    move child cursor
↑↓     scroll detail viewport
enter  open child

Forms
ctrl+o         save or apply
esc            cancel
tab/shift+tab  change field
ctrl+e         open editor
ctrl+u         clear prompt

Filters
/       search
s       cycle status filter
f       filter (form)
c       clear filters
ctrl+r  reset filter form

press ? to return
